<main class="site-main"><section class="page-intro"><p class="section-number">About</p><h1>From psychology to model evaluation.</h1><p>I am Tomer Zipori. I build models, visual explanations, and research tools that make technical claims easier to inspect.</p></section><section class="section background-section"><div class="background-copy"><p>My background spans psychology, experimental methods, statistics, data science, machine learning, and LLM evaluation.</p><p>I focus on a simple method: define a testable claim, build the right instrument, show the evidence, and state the limit.</p><p><a class="text-link" href="../assets/cv/tomer-zipori.pdf">Download CV (PDF)</a></p></div><figure class="portrait"><img src="../assets/profile.jpg" alt="Tomer Zipori outdoors, looking toward the camera"></figure></section><section class="section"><div class="section-heading"><p class="section-number">Publication</p><div><h2>Signal detection, misinformation, and ordinal models.</h2><p>Visualizations from OrdinalRegressionViz accompany the 2026 meta-analysis by Simchon, Zipori, Teitelbaum, Lewandowsky, and van der Linden.</p><p><a class="external-arrow" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.copsyc.2025.102194">Read the journal record</a> · <a href="https://github.com/tomerzipori/OrdinalRegressionViz">See the package</a></p></div></div></section></main>
